audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradicted the already-audited mirror. Our page read Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath; the mirror set Level 2 and Level 3 to Swain and Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Cho'Gath, and the packet chart agrees with the mirror on all four.
audit.why: Our own whys[1], whys[2] and spikes[0] already describe Levels 2-3 as Swain's punish window against a champion with no mobility — the side tokens disagreed with the page's own prose as well as with the mirror.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 flipped to Swain, rows 3 and 4 flipped to Cho'Gath, proposed as matched full/content pairs; ratings on rows 1-2 raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feast is the tracked ability on every line of this page and its cooldown never appears. It is 80/70/60s — long enough that the window after he spends it is the real fight window. Rupture (6s) and Feral Scream (11s at rank 1, 300 range) were likewise unnumbered.
audit.why: 'Don't sit low' is permanent advice; 'he has 80 seconds of no execute' is a window you can act on.
audit.corrected: 80s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, whys[4] and spikes[1].text; Rupture's 6s and Feral Scream's 11s/300 range into dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.
sources: enemyKit Cho'Gath R/Q/W cooldowns and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text claimed 'Cho'Gath cannot burst you through it [R]' and that his knockup 'wastes drain time rather than ending you'. Feast is true damage — it ignores the MR the page tells you to build and the max HP your Soul Fragments stack — and Rupture's knockup is exactly what ends a drain. The page's own whys[6] and late already say this, so the level-6 section contradicted the rest of the entry.
audit.why: Riot's text: R 'dealing a high amount of true damage'; Q 'popping enemy units into the air'.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and whys[4] rewritten to give him level 6, with the knockup named as the drain-breaker and the true damage stated.
sources: enemyKit Cho'Gath Q/R text and flags

edits.before: Your R sustain wins extended drain fights, but you must bait his Q knockup BEFORE activating R or he breaks the drain window; root him first, then commit.
edits.after: Feast arrives as an 80s true-damage execute and Rupture's knockup breaks your drain on demand — he owns this level unless you bait the knockup out before you commit R.

edits.before: R gives you near-permanent drain sustain in extended fights; Cho'Gath cannot burst you through it and his Q knockup wastes drain time rather than ending you.
edits.after: R gives near-permanent drain sustain, but Feast (80s at rank 1) is true damage that ignores it — bait Rupture's knockup first, commit second, and never sit low.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Feast: matchup-defining — True-damage execute. Don’t sit low. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath Feast: matchup-defining — 80s at rank 1 and true damage, so never sit low. Track it before every engage. - Your E: 12s, never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: True-damage execute. Don’t sit low. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: True-damage execute on an 80s timer. Do not sit low; engage once it is spent.

edits.before: Track Cho'Gath's Feast: True-damage execute. Don’t sit low. When it is down — E-root + R him.
edits.after: Feast is 80s and true damage — MR does not stop it. Rupture (6s) breaks your drain; bait it.

edits.before: That is Cho'Gath's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Rupture is a 6s telegraphed knockup — sidestep the ring and his engage is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

notes: The mirror agent flagged that focus.text on the cho'gath side reads 'Swain Demonic Ascension' while focus.letters[0] is 'E' — the letter and the ability disagree.
